vocabulary.definition: A single company workspace; owns Users, Documents, Actions and configuration. MVP runs single-tenant; the model must remain tenant-scoped from day one.
A person authenticated (later via Cognito) within a Tenant; MVP uses an implicit dev user with no auth UI.
An uploaded file (pdf/md/txt) belonging to exactly one Tenant, with id, filename, sha256, size, uploaded_at metadata.
A retrieval unit produced from a Document, retaining the parent document id and a section/locator identifier.
An explicit reference shown to the user tying an Answer to one or more Chunks (document + section + retrieval score).
The assistant's response: either a grounded answer with >=1 Citation, or an abstention (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) with zero fabricated citations.
The explicit act of refusing to answer when retrieved evidence does not clear the confidence threshold.
A state-changing tool call (e.g., create ticket) that requires a validated permission AND an explicit human confirmation before execution.
A golden question with expected source section and/or expected abstention, used to score retrieval and answer fidelity.
The configured minimum retrieval confidence/evidence verdict under which the system must abstain rather than answer.

relationships: Tenant owns many Users; Tenant owns many Documents.
Document decomposes into many Chunks; Citation references one or more Chunks.
Answer cites one or more Citations; an Answer without citations must be an Abstention.
Evaluation Case evaluates one Answer against expected source/abstention.
Controlled Action is initiated by a User and gated by permission + confirmation.
invariants: INV1: Every non-abstaining Answer carries at least one Citation pointing to chunks that actually exist in the Tenant's own documents.
INV2: A Tenant's User can only retrieve from, or cite, Documents owned by that Tenant; cross-tenant retrieval is impossible by construction (enforced in the retrieval/backend layer, never by prompt).
INV3: No state-changing Action executes without (a) permission validation and (b) explicit user confirmation in the same session.
INV4: Every LLM call and retrieval records usage/metadata (tokens, cost when available, latency) in logs sufficient for per-operation cost accounting.
INV5: Answers that reference evidence below the Evidence Threshold are Abstentions; the threshold is configuration, not a prompt instruction.
INV6: Documents are immutable once registered (content addressable by sha256); updates create new versions rather than mutating in place.

open_questions.question: Section-aware chunking for PDFs in MVP: is paragraph-level chunking with filename+paragraph-id locator acceptable for v1 citations?
